title: Token registry CI regression gate (Phase 6)
goal: Add a CI regression gate that validates the central TOKEN_REGISTRY.md target authority: every CSS custom property role resolves to a defined runtime value, every Tailwind projection key maps to a registered role, no unregistered token-source files observed - failing the check on drift so the registry stays the authoritative token source of truth.

in: Machine-checkable TOKEN_REGISTRY.md runtime-source and exact Tailwind projection contract
Focused token-registry regression checker and negative fixtures
Package command and main CI workflow wiring
DESIGN-034 work packet and design-system durable state
out: Runtime token value, CSS cascade, or Tailwind configuration changes
DESIGN-033 radius visual QA and venue-session work
Component-local/module custom properties and broader token adoption

acceptance_criteria: Every live/conflict CSS custom-property role in TOKEN_REGISTRY.md Tables A-I has a definition in a registered global runtime token source.
Every CSS-variable Tailwind projection key maps exactly to an active registered role and an exact TOKEN_REGISTRY.md Table K alias row.
Unregistered global token declarations and non-module global token-source files fail the check; component-local/module properties are explicitly outside the global contract.
Focused negative fixtures prove failure for missing runtime truth, rogue declarations/source files, and Tailwind projection drift.
The focused checker runs in the main CI workflow, with no runtime token-value, Tailwind-config, DESIGN-033, or venue-session changes.

commands: git diff --check -- package.json .github/workflows/ci.yml scripts/ci/check-token-registry.mjs scripts/ci/check-token-registry.test.mjs docs/implementation/ui-ux-completion/TOKEN_REGISTRY.md docs/work-packets/DESIGN-034.md docs/engineering/agents/design-system/STATE.md docs/engineering/tasks/completed/DESIGN-034.json
evidence: Node fixture suite passed 9/9: exact contract accepted; missing active definition, unregistered declaration/source, Tailwind projection drift, minified CSS blind spots, invalid statuses, malformed rows, source-path escape, and flattened alias collisions covered.
Repository token check passed: 126 registry role rows, 69 active runtime variables, 41 Tailwind CSS-variable projections, 2 registered global token sources.
ESLint passed on both new CI files; scoped git diff --check passed.
agents:validate passed with 17 agents / 113 tasks / 0 errors; 8 expected stale-map warnings remain for root reconciliation (agents:generate intentionally not run).
Runtime CSS values and tailwind.config.ts are unchanged; DESIGN-033 and venue-session files are untouched.

progress.summary: Implemented the Phase 6 token-registry regression gate without changing runtime tokens or Tailwind configuration. TOKEN_REGISTRY.md now exposes its two global CSS sources and Tailwind source as a machine-readable contract and records all 41 projections as exact rows. Focused positive/negative fixtures, the real repository check, lint, and diff checks pass; the gate is wired into main CI.
completed: Added the registry parser and validator for Tables A-I, exact Table K projections, runtime definitions/dependencies, registered global CSS sources, and Tailwind var targets.
Normalized grouped Table K aliases into 41 exact projection rows and documented the global-vs-component-local source boundary.
Added four focused fixture tests covering success plus missing runtime truth, rogue declarations/sources, and projection drift.

Review hardening added five fixtures and corrected the checker to parse minified CSS, reject malformed rows instead of dropping them, validate role/projection statuses and repo-relative source paths, reject flattened alias collisions, and skip filesystem symlinks; six historical removed statuses were normalized to dead.
Added check:token-registry and test:token-registry package commands and wired both into .github/workflows/ci.yml.
next_steps: Root orchestrator regenerates shared task maps/TASK_INDEX after integrating concurrent lanes.
Future global token or Tailwind CSS-variable projection changes update TOKEN_REGISTRY.md in the same change.
